ruling.reasoning:
The driver, not the rider, cancelled the trip (app reason rider_no_show, fee $5.00 on record), so this is a no-show case governed by NS-1/NS-2 [F4][NS-0].
NS-1 (i) is satisfied: the driver tapped "I'm Here" at 17:15:05, 40 m from the pickup point at that moment and within 200 m throughout, closet approach 36 m [F7][F1][NS-1].
NS-1 (iii) is satisfied: before cancelling, the driver sent 2 in-app messages (first 17:15:35) and made 1 in-app call (17:16:35), each timestamped, with the call unanswered [F5][F12][F13][NS-1]. The driver stayed at the pickup point, stationary 17:15:05–17:22:55 at a point 40 m away, well within 200 m, so there is no GPS gap [F3][F2][F6].
NS-1 (ii) fails. The applicable wait threshold is the case record's 8 minutes, counted from the later of scheduled pickup time and arrival. The trace settles that the driver waited 470 s (7 min 50 s) continuously from arrival before cancelling, against a 480 s (8 min) threshold [F6][F7][NS-1]. His own messages and statement confirm this: "8 min up, cancelling the trip" was sent at 17:22, i.e. before the eighth minute had in fact elapsed [F11][F14]. He therefore cancelled before the free-wait/threshold time had passed, and the rider was charged for a no-show that had not yet arisen.
Because a NS-1 condition fails, the fee is voided and the rider is refunded in full: refund_full of $5.00 [F8][NS-2]. NS-2's additional flag_account does not apply — the trace confirms arrival was genuine (driver_tap 40 m from the pickup, no fake confirmation), so no account action is warranted [F7][F1][NS-2]. NS-9 is not engaged: the rider has 0 no-show cancellations in the last 90 days, and the profile never decides the current case in any event [F18][NS-9].
Amount follows the trace's allowed outcome: cancellation fee on record $5.00, refunded in full = $5.00 [F8]. Under TH-2 a no-show/cancellation case is decided by the system with a fixed $5.00, and $5.00 is under $10 so the system ruling is final under TH-1 [TH-1][TH-2].
